wholePhysicalScope: Named 18-vertex mapped Lyric Theatre envelope and Great Windmill Street return, KF’s exact public-domain April 2007 photograph, and Historic England’s listed building description.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the mapped theatre, gabled pavilions, canopy and Hunter house. Near levels add the window trim, balustrade and period lettering.
limitations: The April 2007 original guides the photographed brick and stone front, gables, canopied entrance, blade and advertising board. Its signs and carved detail are simplified.

The stage is behind the retained Hunter house. The unpictured stage and auditorium roof profiles, parapets, service openings and relative heights are approximated from the mapped plan and written record.
The elevation field is unchanged. Pavement contacts are estimates sampled from the original elevation tiles.
